authority.note: Ceilings below are the mission's planning limits, not targets to exhaust.

ceilings.real_instrument_outcome_evaluation: prohibited; requires the handback review gate

host_limits_observed.binding_limit: the mission ceiling, not the host; outputs kept compact for the inode quota

counting_conventions.estimator_fit: one execution of an estimator that produces a subspace/projector or decoder from data, including every alternating-least-squares restart, every failed or interrupted attempt, and every pilot fit. Deterministic re-scoring of an existing fit is not a fit.
counting_conventions.inference_replicate: one synthetic Monte-Carlo draw used for coverage, type-I error, or power assessment, counted per generated dataset realisation, not per bootstrap resample within it.
counting_conventions.pilot_vs_confirmation: pilot and design seeds are disjoint from confirmation seeds; a seed used to choose a model, threshold or grid is never used for confirmation.

B0_execution_accounting.rationale: synthetic accounting fixtures only; generates no scientific outcome

T19S_perturbation_observables.rationale: deterministic linear-algebra checks are free; fits are the sample-covariance estimates in the in-domain and stress grids

T20S_risk_decomposition.rationale: alternating-least-squares restarts dominate; each restart is charged

T21S_spike_loadings.rationale: one fit per (geometry, aspect ratio, spike, seed) cell

T22S_design_and_calibration.rationale: synthetic dependence/coverage/type-I/power study; matched-band PCA fits only

reserve.rationale: restarts, failures and re-runs after a defect is found

prohibited: changing success criteria after seeing outcomes
merging main, force-pushing, deleting branches, removing transfer packages

expenditure.note: updated as packages execute; see the per-package accounting ledgers
